# Bibek Sah

> Full Stack Developer in Kathmandu, Nepal with 3 years of professional experience building scalable, production-ready web applications with React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, and Express.js, backed by MongoDB, MySQL, and PostgreSQL.

## About
- Delivered 13+ production web applications across healthcare, education, e-commerce, and corporate sectors at Dwork IT Solutions (Jan 2023 to Jan 2026)
- Built admin dashboards with role-based access control for 6+ client platforms
- Improved load times and Core Web Vitals with SSR, SSG, ISR, code splitting, and lazy loading
- Owns features end to end, from database schema and REST API design to an SEO-optimized, accessible UI
- Studying for a Master of Computer Science and Information Technology (MCSIT) at Pokhara University; open to full-time Full Stack Developer roles

## Selected projects
- [ExamNepal](https://www.examsnepal.com): online examination and learning platform with analytics and an admin dashboard
- [Medishop](https://nepal-medishop-frontend.vercel.app): healthcare e-commerce platform with inventory and order management
- [BabyCare Marketplace](https://www.thebabycareapp.com): multi-vendor marketplace with role-based dashboards
- [LooksCart](https://www.lookscart.com): eyewear e-commerce with secure checkout
- [Dwork-it](https://www.dworkit.com): server-rendered corporate site with structured SEO
